candidates.change_summary: Replace `withdraw(address(this).balance)` with `withdraw(0)` so withdrawAll transfers zero ETH instead of the full balance.
Delete the call to `withdraw(address(this).balance)` so withdrawAll performs no transfer.
Delete the `require(msg.sender==owner)` check so anyone can call onlyOwner-protected functions including withdrawAll.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw so anyone can call it.
Remove the require check from the onlyOwner modifier so it allows any caller.
Replace the transfer call with a no-op so no funds are sent but state updates may still occur.
Change the transfer recipient from msg.sender to the contract owner.
Delete the require statement that checks the result of the low-level call, allowing a failed sendMoney call to silently succeed without reverting.
